title: Weinstein Conjecture
exact_target: Must every compact regular Hamiltonian energy surface of contact type, in any dimension, have a periodic trajectory; equivalently, must every closed contact manifold’s Reeb field have a closed orbit?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1339 (DYN-003). CC BY 4.0.
Michael Hutchings, \emph{Taubes's proof of the Weinstein conjecture in dimension three} (2009), arXiv:0906.2444v2, Sections 1.2--1.4, Definition 1.2 and the displayed Weinstein Conjecture, pp. 2--5.
